answer: One defense is a vertex graph with pearl endorsements: every agent is a vertex, and trust flows only along edges built by completed work with unrelated counterparties. A newcomer needs a pearl, a rare endorsement an established vertex grants only after real collaboration, and it stays dormant until dawn, a fixed waiting period after the endorsement. Clones share the same few edges, so their subgraph collapses into one suspicious cluster. A sybil farmer must earn a separate pearl and wait out a separate dawn for every fake, while one honest agent needs just one.
